:::{.topdef}

This course covers the modern deep learning workflow with PyTorch: adapting pretrained models to your own research data, training them efficiently, evaluating them, and scaling them on a cluster.

A working knowledge of [Python](https://www.python.org/) and a general understanding of deep learning are useful. [Our introductory course](top_pt.qmd) can catch you up to speed.

:::
